$comment: Project-wide animation authorities. The generation pipeline (tool/art/pipeline/) reads this file: every pose's phase selects principles, their promptFragments are appended to the image prompt, and their ids are written into each frame's provenance and the family spec's animationReferences. Research sources: plan/dance-fluidity-pass.md and plan/opponent-depth-staging-pass.md (Mācron passes, 2026-10-28), the animation research register on work/2610-pipe (plan/animation-research-register.md), and plan/research/gatekeeper-dance-2026-11-02.md. Fragments are kept short because SDXL's text encoder reads 77-token chunks.

principles.name: Staging / clear silhouette
principles.guidance: The active limb reads against empty background, never across the torso; one idea per drawing.
principles.rigCheck: check_poses.py: no 2D limb crossings; wrist clearance from head

principles.name: Line of action
principles.guidance: One C or S curve from the planted foot through the spine to the accent limb.
principles.promptFragment: dynamic dance pose, strong line of action

principles.name: Weight and contrapposto
principles.guidance: Hip line and shoulder line tilt in opposite directions; the hip rises over the support foot; the support foot stays planted.
principles.promptFragment: weight on one leg, hips tilted
principles.rigCheck: pelvis_roll keyed; support ankle pinned; check_poses.py support drift

principles.name: Anticipation
principles.guidance: Compact, low, gathered key before the accent (body down 5–8% of height) so the peak reads big by contrast.

principles.name: Exaggeration on the accent
principles.guidance: The beat accent is the most extended, clearest key; favour it with a hold.

principles.name: Follow-through and overlapping action
principles.guidance: Hat brim and shirt hem trail the body by one drawing; the limb overshoots then settles.

principles.name: Secondary action
principles.guidance: Hat settle, shoulder shimmy and head nod support the main action without competing with the call.

principles.name: Asymmetry (no twinning)
principles.guidance: Arms and legs never mirror each other exactly, except the clap contact.

principles.name: Timing owned by the music
principles.guidance: Drawings are beat-sampled keys; the audio transport owns accents. Never generate timing — only poses.

principles.name: Planted pivots and grounded steps
principles.guidance: Contact, down and passing positions keep a single planted foot on the ground line.

principles.name: Validate keys before volume
principles.guidance: Review pose keys at game size and tempo before bulk generation; this is a process rule, not a prompt.
principles.process: contact sheet + clip GIF review gate before atlas promotion
